native_adaptations: Typed TableHeaders::Cells/Rows separates flat and nested PHP arrays; direct flat iterators keep familiar calls.
DefinitionListItem::Title/Entries/Separator models PHP variadic string/array/separator union via an iterator; unsupported categories fail compilation.
Entry arrays retain order and emptiness; only first pair is used, not every pair.
Nullable scalar cell has a private null marker for PHP isset; empty text remains present; explicit TableCell objects remain present. No new dependency or parallel renderer.
Success adds one LF through existing NewLineAware state; failure preserves partial bytes and cause without success LF.
